source: local actual CLI + signed SDK + official agent in QEMU/KVM guest

input.UserData:
#!/bin/bash
set -eux
exec > >(tee /var/log/stackd-ssm-bootstrap.log /dev/console) 2>&1
systemctl stop amazon-ssm-agent.service snap.amazon-ssm-agent.amazon-ssm-agent.service || true
mkdir -p /etc/amazon/ssm /usr/local/share/ca-certificates
printf %s '' | base64 -d > /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/stackd-ssm.crt
update-ca-certificates
printf %s '' | base64 -d > /etc/amazon/ssm/amazon-ssm-agent.json
printf '%s\n' '10.194.0.1 s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com stackd-ssm-guest-6ffe6371a1.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com' >> /etc/hosts
curl --fail --retry 3 http://10.194.0.1:48667/amazon-ssm-agent.deb -o /var/tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.deb
dpkg -i /var/tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.deb
systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
systemctl start amazon-ssm-agent
amazon-ssm-agent -version
printf 'STACKD_OFFICIAL_AGENT_BOOTSTRAPPED\n'
(for delay in 25 35 60; do sleep "$delay"; cat /var/log/amazon/ssm/amazon-ssm-agent.log > /dev/console; done) &
